Episodes.Title: Beach Please
Episodes.Description: JR comes to Matt's rescue after Cha asked the latter out on a surf date. However, the barista considers ditching the plan when Ime disapproves of her action.

Episodes.Title: MattCha
Episodes.Description: Matt ends up enjoying his surf date with Cha. An untoward incident brings them closer, but those around them seem unhappy about it. Later, Cha makes a realization.

Episodes.Title: Sus
Episodes.Description: Cha's suspicions about Matt grow stronger as they become text mates while recovering from their sprains. To confirm her hunch, the barista pays her friend a surprise visit, only to lead to more confusion.

Episodes.Title: Yellow There Mysteryoso
Episodes.Description: Cha finally confirms that the person standing before her is not the same Matt she met online. After a heartfelt talk with Marian, Matt goes out of his way to find Cha and confess.

Episodes.Title: Breadcrumbing
Episodes.Description: Matt finds it difficult to come clean to Cha as they spend more time together at the coffee farm. However, a sudden request will bring them back to square one.

Episodes.Title: Confused Hearts
Episodes.Description: Refusing to ruin the happy moment he shares with Cha, Matt once again decides to postpone his confession and instead tries to boost JR's image with her. However, to Matt's surprise and confusion, Cha agrees to meet JR and go on a date with him.

Episodes.Title: Busted
Episodes.Description: Matt is forced to do the right thing when JR fails to come clean to Cha, only to hurt the barista's feelings unintentionally. Meanwhile, Marian discovers an anomaly under JR's watch and reports it to Leandro.

Episodes.Title: Catching Feelings
Episodes.Description: Cha struggles to accept that she is catching feelings for the real Matt, despite the deceit. Despite doing the right thing, guilt weighs on Matt for hurting two of the most important people in his life.

Episodes.Title: Manifesting
Episodes.Description: JR apologizes to Cha and learns that Ayat Blends is about to close down. While JR plans to take advantage of Cha's dilemma to win her over, Matt finds a thoughtful way to help her and the displaced workers.

Episodes.Title: Trabahohol
Episodes.Description: Despite her initial rejection, Cha decides to accept the job offer at Legacy Cafe for the sake of her team. Matt tries to be professional with Cha on her first day, while Marian reunites with Vivian after receiving a task from Leandro.

Episodes.Title: Special Treatment
Episodes.Description: Despite Matt's effort to clear the air between them, Cha remains reluctant as she becomes determined to fight her growing feelings for him. Meanwhile, JR seizes an opportunity to get closer to Cha, causing Matt to seethe with jealousy.

Episodes.Title: One Shot
Episodes.Description: JR finds a new opportunity to spend time alone with Cha. This time, Matt refuses to let them be, even going so far as to see JR flirting with the girl he likes.

Episodes.Title: Best Man
Episodes.Description: With her parents’ support, Cha grows determined to revive Ayat Blends Café. Matt confesses his true feelings for Cha to JR and finally decides to pursue her. Unwilling to back down, JR steps up his game—both at work and in winning Cha’s heart.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Found
Episodes.Description: When Cha loses her precious necklace, Matt and JR both rush to help her find it, each with their own approach to winning her favor. While JR spends more time with Cha at work, Matt focuses on making amends with Cha’s parents.

Episodes.Title: Perfectly Imperfect
Episodes.Description: Seeing JR feeling down after a tense confrontation with his father, Cha steps in as a friend. Upon learning of JR's dilemma, Matt, without hesitation, rushes to his aid, which leads Cha to a new lead in the scam that started it all.

Episodes.Title: Sigma Wars
Episodes.Description: JR takes Cha to the beach to keep her from going to the precinct. A surfing match breaks out when Ime spots Cha and JR together and orders Matt to separate them.

Episodes.Title: And the Winner Is
Episodes.Description: The rivalry between Matt and JR intensifies as they ramp up their efforts to win Cha's favor. Despite the new developments in the scam case, Cha finds little cause for celebration, caught between two good friends now at odds because of her.

Episodes.Title: Passenger Princess
Episodes.Description: Not wanting to put too much pressure on Cha, Matt and JR set aside their differences and reach a compromise. JR is frozen in place upon hearing the news of Jackie Bartolome’s arrest.

Episodes.Title: Red Alert
Episodes.Description: Cha and Matt's trip to the precinct proves futile when the authorities refuse to let her speak with Jackie Bartolome. As the case begins to take its toll on Cha, JR and Matt decide to call a truce.

Episodes.Title: White Flag
Episodes.Description: After Cha's alarming panic attack, Matt makes a thoughtful gesture to help her feel better. Later, Matt overhears JR’s phone conversation and finally discovers his friend’s true colors.

Episodes.Title: The Truth Will Set You Free
Episodes.Description: Setting aside his feelings, Matt tries to make Cha understand where JR is coming from. Leandro promises to stand by his son upon learning of his situation.

Episodes.Title: Night 2 Remember
Episodes.Description: Matt and JR face off once again, this time in a coffee-making contest during Legacy’s anniversary night. As this year’s best barista, Cha gets the final say in selecting the winning brew—and ultimately, the man who will win her heart.

Entries.Title: Voltes V: Legacy
Entries.Description: Voltes V: Legacy follows the story of three brothers, Steve, Big Bert, and Little Jon Armstrong, and their friends Jamie Robinson and Mark Gordon, as they fight the forces of humanoid aliens known as Boazanians who plans to invade the earth and launch their beast fighters all over the world.

Episodes.Title: Voltes V vs. the Boazanian Empire
Episodes.Description: The Earth is under attack by an alien menace known as the Boazanian Forces. A special group of people who have been properly trained to deal with this kind of emergency pilots the Voltes V robot to fight and defend humanity.

Episodes.Title: Hrothgar’s revolt against the Boazanians
Episodes.Description: Hrothgar demonstrates his capabilities with his impressive inventions and generous demeanor and is soon selected to be the next ruler of Boazania. However, Zambojil, the son of the late emperor, becomes determined to prevent this from happening.

Episodes.Title: Hrothgar meets Mary Ann
Episodes.Description: Hrothgar and slave rebels battle the Boazanian soldiers. Before they are captured, the rebels aid Hrothgar's escape with his airship. He pledges to return and rescue the rebels from the empire.

Episodes.Title: Terra Erthu’s ‘Voltes V’ Project
Episodes.Description: Mary Ann gives Hrothgar a new name, Ned Armstrong. They soon fall in love and have two sons, Steve and Big Bert. Meanwhile, Ned and the Earth's leaders build Camp Big Falcon, the base for the powerful robot Voltes V.

Episodes.Title: Camp Big Falcon's greatest weapon
Episodes.Description: Ned returns to Boazan to fulfill his promise and free the hornless slaves from Emperor Zambojil. In Boazan, Emperor Zambojil tells the young Zardoz about his treacherous father. Zardoz remains loyal to the Empire.

Episodes.Title: Takeover
Episodes.Description: Dr. Smith introduces the five Volt machines to the cadets. As Ned returns to planet Boazan, the Boazan soldiers try to capture him.

Episodes.Title: Alpha Team
Episodes.Description: Zardoz bids Boazan farewell to invade planet Earth. Steve faces a military officer who thinks that he is arrogant and fires at him.

Episodes.Title: Destiny to Fulfill
Episodes.Description: Zardoz' generals inform him that they could hasten their voyage to Earth and reach Terra Erthu in a month's time. Meanwhile, Mary Ann discovers that Little Jon had gone to the forbidden area.

Episodes.Title: Earth on Alert
Episodes.Description: The Armstrong brothers are now suspicious of their superhuman abilities and will go to any length to discover the truth.

Episodes.Title: World Under Attack
Episodes.Description: The Boazanian empire led by Zardoz finally arrived at Terra Erthu to conquer the world where Hrothgar was hiding. What steps will Camp Big Falcon take to save their world?

Episodes.Title: Volt In
Episodes.Description: The Voltes team is finally revealed! Will the team win against the strength of the Boazanian empire to save planet Earth from destruction?

Episodes.Title: Sanib Pwersa
Episodes.Description: An all out war between the Voltes V and the Boazanians is about to happen! Will the new heroes of planet Earth be successful in their mission, or will they fall into the hands of Zardoz?

Episodes.Title: Destroy Voltes V
Episodes.Description: What will be the next step of Zardoz and his Boazanian army after their unexpected defeat at the hands of the new saviors of the Earth, Voltes V?

Episodes.Title: Vaizanger
Episodes.Description: After facing Voltes V, the Boazanians cannot accept defeat and have decided to make another beast fighter called, Vaizanger.

Episodes.Title: Skull Ship
Episodes.Description: An unexpected event occurs at Camp Big Falcon while Voltes V is in the middle of training. Are they ready to face the Boazanian army again?

Episodes.Title: Target
Episodes.Description: As the Boazanians attack Terra Erthu, many lives will be put in danger, including the life of Mary Anne after she failed to enter Camp Big Falcon.

Episodes.Title: Rise Armstrong Brothers
Episodes.Description: What can Mary Anne do to help Voltes V defeat Zardoz and the Boazanian army?

Episodes.Title: Armstrong Brothers
Episodes.Description: What will life be like for the Armstrong boys now that their loving and caring mother, Mary Anne, is gone?

Episodes.Title: Spy
Episodes.Description: The Armstrong brothers seek a means of coping and forgetting the grief of losing their mother after she passed away.

Episodes.Title: Tragic Past
Episodes.Description: Will Mark understand the pain of the Armstrong brothers if he finally discovers what happened to his mother?

Episodes.Title: Change of Heart
Episodes.Description: Zardoz and the Boazanian army are ready to attack Terra Erthu with their newest beast fighter, Gardo. Will they successfully conquer the planet this time?

Episodes.Title: Game Plan
Episodes.Description: Voltes V will be in a precarious situation because of the unique strength and skill of the new Boazanian beast fighter, Gardo. Will this be Zardoz's key to conquering Terra Erthu?

Episodes.Title: Butterfly Return Technique
Episodes.Description: Will Steve still have time to learn the butterfly return technique to fight Gardo before it penetrates Camp Big Falcon.

Episodes.Title: Undercover
Episodes.Description: Jamie suspects that Eva is plotting something against their back.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Jamie's life will be in danger because an unknown person will attempt to take her life. Will they be able to identify the culprit?

Episodes.Title: Octo-1
Episodes.Description: Will Steve be able to act as a big brother to his siblings, even though it's causing tension between him and Big Bert?

Episodes.Title: Spy Unveiled
Episodes.Description: Big Bert allows Judy to visit Camp Big Falcon even though it is against their rules. What information can Judy gather as she infiltrates the opponent's camp?

Episodes.Title: Bistado
Episodes.Description: Big Bert plans on retiring in the Voltes 5 team but Steve is against it.

Episodes.Title: Boazanian Among Us
Episodes.Description: Now that Judy knows that Big Bert is part of the Voltes team, will she still pursue the task given by Zardos?

Episodes.Title: Daiga Beastfighter
Episodes.Description: The lives of Little Jon and the people at Camp Big Falcon are in danger. What danger awaits them, and who is at fault for it?

Episodes.Title: Beastfighter in Tandem
Episodes.Description: How will the Voltes team save Camp Big Falcon and Little Jon from the attacks of the Boazanians?

Episodes.Title: Dainegu
Episodes.Description: Will the strength of the Voltes team be enough to fight against the two beast fighets, Negg and Daiga?

Episodes.Title: Attack
Episodes.Description: Steve has finally learned the secret of Judy, and the latter has pleaded to keep it a secret from Big Bert.

Episodes.Title: Death Threat
Episodes.Description: Will Zardoz and the Boazanian empire finally be successful in winning the battle against Voltes V with the help of their powerful beast fighter, Daineegu?

Episodes.Title: Enemy Within
Episodes.Description: Steve realizes that he is ready to admit his feelings for Jamie but what if he also finds out that Mark feels the same way about Jamie.

Episodes.Title: Bombos
Episodes.Description: General Zuhl comes up with a new strategy to defeat Voltes V. Will Prince Zardoz be happy with the general's plans?

Episodes.Title: Namazuka
Episodes.Description: After gathering information about the core strength of Voltes V, will the Boazanians succeed in creating another beast fighter that can defeat Voltes V and conquer Terra Erthu?

Episodes.Title: Close Call
Episodes.Description: The Voltes V team has finally met their newest opponent, Namazuka. Meanwhile, the team is struggling to make the volt in sequence because of the cutting-edge technology.

Episodes.Title: Ultra Marcon
Episodes.Description: Dr. Smith thinks of an alternative plan to save their planet from the wrath of the Boazanians while the members of the Voltes V are still recovering.

Episodes.Title: Mysterious Man
Episodes.Description: After losing the fight against Voltes V, Zardoz devises a new strategy to gather more information about Voltes V.

Episodes.Title: The Impostor
Episodes.Description: Prince Zardoz successfully infiltrates Camp Big Falcon to gather information about Voltes V.

Episodes.Title: Zardoz and Voltes V
Episodes.Description: After a successful infiltration in Camp Big Falcon, will Prince Zardoz be trimphant in his next mission to gather more information about Voltes V with his new identity as Manuel?

Episodes.Title: Attack Orders
Episodes.Description: Dr. Smith begins to suspect Manuel's real motive.

Episodes.Title: New Strategy
Episodes.Description: After his successful mission at Camp Big Falcon, Prince Zardoz discovers the Voltes team's vulnerability. Will this information be enough for their next mission to conquer Terra Erthu?

Episodes.Title: Emotional Return
Episodes.Description: How will Ned Amstrong's sudden return to Camp Big Falcon affect the Armstrong brothers and the rest of the Voltes team?

Episodes.Title: Octo-1 Investigation
Episodes.Description: Ned Armstrong's unexpected return to Camp Big Falcon brings a lot of questions to the Voltes team. Is Ned a real one, or is he only an impostor from Boazan?

Episodes.Title: Dr. Smith
Episodes.Description: Will Dr. Smith and the other members of the Voltes team discover that Ned Armstrong, the one who returned to Camp Big Falcon, is a Bozanian spy?

Episodes.Title: Gamera
Episodes.Description: After Steve discovers that Ned is an impostor, he will make sure that he pays for what he did to Dr. Smith.

Episodes.Title: Dr. Hook
Episodes.Description: Can the Voltes team be able to stand against Zardos and the Boazanians after losing Dr. Smith?

Episodes.Title: Move It
Episodes.Description: Dr. Hook take Dr. Smith’s position in leading the Voltes team’s fight against Boazanian. Does the new commander possess enough knowledge to help in their mission?

Episodes.Title: Spin Fly Technique
Episodes.Description: It seems that Steve, Big Bert, Little Jon, Mark and Jamie are unsatisfied with the way Dr. Hook manages their team. What will happen to the Voltes team if the tension between them and their new leader continues?

Episodes.Title: Home Coming
Episodes.Description: After recognizing that Dr. Hook might help them defeat the Boazanians, the Voltes team agreed to train with him.

Episodes.Title: Taken
Episodes.Description: The Voltes team will have an encounter with Ned Armstrong, but after experiencing Zardoz's deception, they will be hesitant to trust Ned Armstrong.

Episodes.Title: Knight Beast Fighter
Episodes.Description: Will Big Bert succeed in his plans to save Ned from the hands of the Boazanians.

Episodes.Title: Secret Codes
Episodes.Description: Voltes V will have another encounter with Zoldier! Will they defeat the beast fighter this time to continue their search for Ned Armstrong?

Episodes.Title: Big Surprise
Episodes.Description: A new Boazanian guest will catch the Voltes team off guard, making them concerned about whether it is a new opponent.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Consequence
Episodes.Description: Will the Voltes team find out the hideout place of the Boazanians because of General Zuhl's lead information, or will it only lead the team to disaster?

Episodes.Title: The Strongest Metal
Episodes.Description: Zardoz successfully captivated the four Voltes V members because of General Zuhl. Will the Voltes team escape the wrath of the prince of Boazan?

Episodes.Title: Okozenia
Episodes.Description: Prince Zardoz will receive great help with the arrival of General Oslack on their side. Will these joined forces be enough for the Boazanians to defeat Voltes V?

Episodes.Title: Mechanical Eagle
Episodes.Description: The Voltes team will engage in another major battle, and as a result of this clash, they will discover that Voltes V’s weapons are insufficient to destroy their opponents.

Episodes.Title: Replica
Episodes.Description: Steve feels jealous and miserable after learning about Jamie's and Mark's relationship.

Episodes.Title: Savior Returns
Episodes.Description: The Voltes team will have a problem after Mark and Steve's friendship is destroyed, will they be able to defend the world against another Boazanian beast fighter now that Voltes V is not complete?

Episodes.Title: Mysterious Capsule
Episodes.Description: Victory is on the side of Voltes V after defeating Boazanian’s beast fighter with the help of the Mechanical Eagle! But will the team discover who is behind this aircraft?

Episodes.Title: Ned's Plan
Episodes.Description: With Desler returning to the fight, the Mechanical Eagle will also return to help Voltes V. Will the Voltes team find out what their new ally's motives are and why it continues to help them?

Episodes.Title: Orders of Assassination
Episodes.Description: Voltes V will return the favor to the Mechanical Eagle as they save it from the savage attacks of the Boazanians, and as a result, the Armstrong brothers will learn something about their father, Ned.

Episodes.Title: Paglusob
Episodes.Description: Zardoz confronts Steve and challenge him in a one-on-one duel.

Episodes.Title: Steve vs. Zardoz
Episodes.Description: General Robinson will find out about the current conflict between Steve and Mark because of Jamie.

Episodes.Title: Ambush
Episodes.Description: What could be the reason for General Robinson's decision to step down from his position as the commander of Earth's defense force?

Episodes.Title: Commander Robinson
Episodes.Description: Oslack will use Jamie against his father, General Robinson. Will the General of the Boazanians succeed in his evil plans to capture one of the Voltes team's generals?

Episodes.Title: Letter from Robinson
Episodes.Description: General Draco will face Steve Armstrong and try to find out his secret using his invented germ. Meanwhile, Jamie is still not in good condition after his father's death

Episodes.Title: Under Attack
Episodes.Description: Zardoz discovers that the Armstrong brothers' identities are not what they appear to be.

Episodes.Title: The Culprit
Episodes.Description: Will Jamie recover quickly from the assault she suffered at the hands of an assailant, or will she have the same fate as her father, General Robinson?

Episodes.Title: Takeo Arisa
Episodes.Description: Prince Zardoz's new troops, Contessa Zaki, Arisa, and Takeo have arrived! Are they capable enough to withstand the power of Voltes V?

Episodes.Title: Locked Up
Episodes.Description: Eva will try her luck again to be a part of the Voltes team while Jamie is in recovery. Meanwhile, Contessa Zaki will start the first phase of her plans to defeat Voltes V.

Episodes.Title: Face Off
Episodes.Description: The Voltes team will face another Boazanian enemy. Will these new opponents bring an end to Voltes V?

Episodes.Title: Battle
Episodes.Description: Zaki challenged the Voltes team with her twin warriors.

Episodes.Title: Conquer
Episodes.Description: As the Voltes team escapes from the hands of the Boazanians, a severe punishment awaits the twin warriors, Takeo and Arisa.

Episodes.Title: Attack the Rebels
Episodes.Description: Prince Zardoz and his fleet attack Camp Big Falcon and the secret base of the Boazanian rebels simultaneously, which will be a tough decision on the Voltes team on who they should help first!

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Can Voltes V defeat Zunaizer to aid Dr. Ned Armstrong and the other Boazanian rebels in their battle against Prince Zardoz’s army?

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: Zardos suspects that someone within his camp is betraying him and helping the Voltes team.

Episodes.Title: Search for Ned
Episodes.Description: The Voltes V have finally discovered Zardoz's secret lair and want to end his reigh once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Infiltration
Episodes.Description: Will Prince Zardoz face defeat after Zander and Oslack join forces to disrupt his plans?

Episodes.Title: Honor
Episodes.Description: Will the Voltes team secure the victory after winning against Prince Zardoz’s one of the most dependable generals, Draco?

Episodes.Title: World Destruction
Episodes.Description: Voltes V will face a big problem because of the bomb planted by General Oslack. Will the Voltes team be able to destroy it before it’s too late?

Episodes.Title: Solar Falcon
Episodes.Description: The Voltes team and the Boazanian rebels join forces to save Ned Armstrong and the other captives of Emperor Zambojil.

Episodes.Title: Uprising
Episodes.Description: The Camp Falcon suddenly encounters Zu Zambojil’s most powerful weapon after reaching the planet Boazan.

Episodes.Title: Domination
Episodes.Description: Will the Boazanian empire meet its downfall after the Voltes team and the Boazanian Rebels reach their planet?

Episodes.Title: Tagapagligtas
Episodes.Description: Will the Voltes team and the Boazanian rebels finally achieve victory they have been longing for?

Episodes.Title: Never Surrender
Episodes.Description: In Voltes V’s mission to achieve peace, the god of war of Boazan will hinder them. Is this the final enemy that they must defeat to achieve victory?

Episodes.Title: One Epic Finale
Episodes.Description: The Voltes V triumphs against their Boazanian enemies and finally brings the long-awaited peace to Boazan.

Entries.Title: Senior High
Entries.Description: A student’s death causes a scandal at the prestigious Northford High. Investigations conclude it was a suicide. The victim’s twin sister thinks otherwise. As she searches for truth, she will unravel secrets that are far more shocking and dangerous.

Episodes.Title: Hello, Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Following her grandmother's death, Sky is forced to live with her estranged family members and go to Northford High School, where her twin sister Luna attends for a bright future. However, that dream suddenly turns bleak when tragedy comes upon them.

Episodes.Title: Bullied
Episodes.Description: The authorities conclude that Luna's tragic fate is self-inflicted, but Lydia remains convinced that there is foul play. Later, Sky is left shocked and alarmed after discovering a disturbing video involving her late twin sister.

Episodes.Title: Person of Interest
Episodes.Description: Sky stumbles upon unsettling videos of Luna being bullied by Z. She shows it to Tania, only to be surprised that her mother knows what her twin sister went through all along. Archie discovers Harry’s dirty secret.

Episodes.Title: Connections
Episodes.Description: As Sky dives deeper into her theory, she learns that Luna was romantically involved with one of Northford High’s students. Meanwhile, Lydia conducts her own investigation into Luna’s death.

Episodes.Title: Blood Ties
Episodes.Description: Sky probes Obet about his past relationship with Luna. Archie ends up in the hospital after taking dangerous drugs. Fed up with his father's harsh words, Archie stuns Harry with another revelation.

Episodes.Title: Set-up
Episodes.Description: Rumors about Archie's drug incident start circulating in Northford. Sky makes up for her low grades by accomplishing a special assignment, but an enemy tries to sabotage her. Refusing to back down, the tough newbie finds a way to retaliate.

Episodes.Title: Gaslighting
Episodes.Description: Things do not go as planned for Sky when she comes face-to-face with Z and Northford's influential families in a meeting. Obet finds himself in a risky situation when Lydia and the school heighten the alert for illegal activities among students.

Episodes.Title: Father of the Year
Episodes.Description: Taking notice of the tension between Tania and Harry during a school event, Luna finds a way to confirm her hunch. After getting a reality check from her own daughter, Tania finally gathers all the courage and issues the Aguerros a stern warning.

Episodes.Title: Raid
Episodes.Description: Sky presses Tania into revealing the truth behind the latter’s relationship with Harry. Obet gets pressured by his older brother to skip classes and sell drugs to Archie.

Episodes.Title: Consequences
Episodes.Description: Obet and Archie find themselves on the verge of getting caught by the authorities for their illegal dealing. Tania faces another dilemma when an unexpected person ends up in her shop. Harry and Sasha receive upsetting news about their children.

Episodes.Title: Allies
Episodes.Description: Tania brings the intoxicated Archie home from her shop, only for the latter to reveal her and Harry's secret in front of the Aguerros. Sky finds an ally in Lydia after discovering a crucial detail about her twin sister's death from the lady guard.

Episodes.Title: Aftermath
Episodes.Description: Sasha leaves the family home following her discovery of Harry's betrayal. Despite Tania's objections, Sky continues to investigate and tries to get her hands on CCTV footage in Northford, unaware that another person shares the same goal.

Episodes.Title: Deep Fake
Episodes.Description: A video of Z bullying Luna resurfaces, this time with a different face of the assailant. Lydia catches a colleague red-handed performing a clandestine activity inside the campus.

Episodes.Title: Abducted
Episodes.Description: Lydia informs Principal Amanda that Domeng tampered with the school's CCTV. A collaboration project shakes up the status quo in Northford Senior High School. Soon, an unforeseen danger befalls Sky.

Episodes.Title: Collab
Episodes.Description: Harry attempts to do damage control by striking a deal with Sky and forcing his other children to apologize to the latter. The preparations begin for the class collab project. Sky sets her sights on obtaining the investigation files of Luna's case.

Episodes.Title: Governor's Ball
Episodes.Description: Sky and her friends receive unexpected invitations to the Governor's Ball. Despite his father's disapproval, Gino remains determined to make his band perform at the party. Later, Sky overhears a shocking conversation concerning her sister's death.

Episodes.Title: Target
Episodes.Description: Harry suspects that Sky overheard his conversation with William regarding Luna's death and tries to intimidate the student. After telling Roxy and Tim about her discovery, Sky thinks of a plan to uncover the truth.

Episodes.Title: Abused
Episodes.Description: William refuses to take Gino and Cecille’s underhanded scheme lightly. Punished by his father, Gino receives help from an unlikely source. Tanya finally gives in to Sky’s request and hands the latter Luna’s police and autopsy reports.

Episodes.Title: Stealth
Episodes.Description: Collab partners clash amid their preparations for their project. Meanwhile, Sky finds an opportunity to get close to the Acostas as she stops at nothing to uncover the truth behind Luna's death.

Episodes.Title: Presetation
Episodes.Description: Sky moves to search for evidence in the Acosta household and later reveals her recent discoveries to Lydia. Archie finds a malicious way to exact revenge on Roxy amid the students' collab project presentations.

Episodes.Title: Note
Episodes.Description: Just when Archie thought he had gained the upper hand against Roxy and Tim, Harry decides to teach his willful son a lesson. Sky's suspicion toward Gino grows when she finds a puzzling note written by Luna for the young Acosta.

Episodes.Title: Get Even
Episodes.Description: Roxy and Tim settle scores with Archie, but their plan takes an unexpected turn when a witness resorts to blackmail. Gino comes clean to Sky about his true relationship with Luna, only to get blamed for the latter's death.

Episodes.Title: Abuse
Episodes.Description: Gino warns his friends about Sky's suspicions. Meanwhile, Sky helps her abused classmate seek justice against Vice Principal Castrodes. However, an unexpected name emerges as one of the victims after more students decide to come forward.

Episodes.Title: Damage Control
Episodes.Description: Believing that Vice Principal Castrodes is the culprit in Luna's case, Tania and Sky rush to the precinct to confront the sexual offender. As Northford tightens its security, Lydia finds a chance to get hold of some CCTV footage to obtain evidence.

Episodes.Title: Hard Drive
Episodes.Description: Sky, Lydia, and Obet try to find ways to open the password-riddled hard drive containing the school's CCTV videos. Roxy and Tim find their backs to the wall when Archie turns to blackmail after discovering their recent act of revenge against him.

Episodes.Title: Caught on Camera
Episodes.Description: Lydia inches closer to confirming her hunches surrounding Luna's death as Obet's hacker pal successfully opens the CCTV files. Meanwhile, news about the missing hard drive reaches William, prompting him to warn Gino and the latter's friends.

Episodes.Title: Blame Game
Episodes.Description: Poch finds himself in dire straits when the CCTV footage disproving his lie during the investigation into Luna's death surfaces. As Poch's confession sparks accusations against their children, Harry and William look for a way to absolve them.

Episodes.Title: Alibi
Episodes.Description: Poch and Archie make up an alibi to clear their names from accusations of being involved in Luna's death, much to Tania's distress. While Archie and Z turn their backs on him, the lone Robles receives help from the Acostas.

Episodes.Title: House Guest
Episodes.Description: In a bid to control the narrative being spread against them, the Acostas offer their home to Poch. However, Tania and Sky refuse to let Archie's group off the hook with Luna's demise.

Episodes.Title: Bread Crumbs
Episodes.Description: Lydia notices something amiss about the retrieved CCTV files. An unexpected witness approaches Sky to disclose an incident that would further pin the blame on Poch. Later, Harry pressures the young Robles into confessing the whole truth.

Episodes.Title: New Lead
Episodes.Description: Tania and Sky face another roadblock in their quest to find justice for Luna as men in power continue to sway the investigation in favor of their children. Wanting to get on Z and Archie's good side, Kenjie sets up Sky during an exam.

Episodes.Title: Not a Cheater
Episodes.Description: Sky faces suspension because of cheating allegations as Kenjie denies setting her up. Fortunately, a concerned fellow student delves deep into the incident and bravely steps forward to reveal the truth.

Episodes.Title: Tables Turned
Episodes.Description: As Z and Kenji's scheme gets exposed, Sky retakes and successfully passes her exams. The fallout leaves Z suspended, drawing the wrath of Harry and the sympathy of Sasha. Lydia finally retrieves the missing part of the CCTV footage.

Episodes.Title: Pusher
Episodes.Description: Under mounting pressure, Lydia forces Obet into divulging Tonio's hustle as a drug pusher. Sky, Tim, and Roxy stumble upon a potential trump card against Poch.

Episodes.Title: Bad Brother
Episodes.Description: Lydia fails to convince Tonio to surrender to the police, leading to his eventual capture in an entrapment operation. Feeling betrayed, Sky confronts Obet and Lydia for covering up Tonio's actions.

Episodes.Title: Walk of Shame
Episodes.Description: Harry uses the implications of Tonio's involvement in Luna's case to warn Tania and Sky against pursuing the investigations further. Lydia suffers the consequences of her grandson's actions. Tim and Roxy capture a crucial moment involving Poch.

Episodes.Title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
Episodes.Description: Darius talks to Sky regarding Luna's case. Sasha sabotages Tania's tattoo shop, much to Z's delight. Lydia anonymously sends the missing hard drive to Principal Perino, but the vital piece of evidence ends up in the hands of William.

Episodes.Title: Luna's Secret
Episodes.Description: As Harry obstructs the investigation into Luna's case, Sky uses the information she obtained from Tim and Roxy to blackmail Poch and get the truth out of him. However, Poch's confession leaves her crestfallen.

Episodes.Title: Who's the Father?
Episodes.Description: Confronted by Sky about Luna's pregnancy, Tania refuses to drag her deceased daughter into another scandal. While Harry agrees to discuss the matter with Tania, Darius learns about Luna's shocking secret.

Episodes.Title: Coerced
Episodes.Description: Lydia learns about Tonio's plight inside the prison. Sanya invites both Sky's and Z's groups to her debut party. Sky decides to meet with Inspector Soledad to discuss her recent findings about Luna's past, unaware that Harry is on her tail.

Episodes.Title: Title
Episodes.Description: Sky burns with anger and disbelief when Tania tries to bridge the gap between her and Harry for Luna's sake. Lydia resolves to put justice in her own hands. Gino is left with no choice but to defend Sky when Z attacks her out of jealousy.

Episodes.Title: Broken Trust
Episodes.Description: Sky struggles to trust Tania again after learning that her mother connived with Harry to cover up Luna's pregnancy. Inspector Soledad uncovers significant information that may solve Luna's case.

Episodes.Title: Deal
Episodes.Description: Poch sees through Tim's plan to get more information about Luna's pregnancy from him. Z throws another fit, putting Sky and Roxy in danger. In an attempt to protect his sister, Archie tries to make a deal with their nemesis.

Episodes.Title: Zyrah's Wish
Episodes.Description: Lydia attempts to talk Tonio into cooperating with Sky. Z suffers a meltdown after learning about Luna's pregnancy, pushing Harry to make a promise to his daughter.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Benefactor
Episodes.Description: Cecille gets a taste of William's wrath anew when he discovers that his wife has been helping fund Sky's stay at Northford. Sky's interrogation of Tonio leads to a revelation of her family's secret to Lydia and Obet.

Episodes.Title: Defense?
Episodes.Description: Sky learns from Inspector Soledad that Harry is keeping Luna's embryonic DNA sample. This information reaches Tania, who takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Tim finds Poch defending him against a rival player's dirty basketball moves.

Episodes.Title: First Move
Episodes.Description: Sky and Gino share a special moment on stage at Sanya's birthday party. Tim tries to comfort a distraught and drunk Poch, but his friendly gesture unexpectedly leads to something more.

Episodes.Title: Catching Feelings
Episodes.Description: Z's attempt to humiliate Sky at Sanya's birthday party backfires and karma soon comes back to bite her. Meanwhile, Sky and Gino grow closer to each other.

Episodes.Title: Unpaid Dues
Episodes.Description: Sky gets informed by Principal Amanda that her tuition is not yet fully paid, putting her future at Northford in jeopardy. Harry sees red as he tries to catch Sasha cheating on him.

Episodes.Title: Another Scandal
Episodes.Description: Another scandal breaks out in Northford Senior High School after Sasha exposes Luna's pregnancy to get back at Sky. This shocking revelation, meanwhile, sends Wiliam into a panic as it may implicate Gino and tarnish his reputation.

Episodes.Title: The Disappearance
Episodes.Description: William informs Harry that they will put plan B into action as news about Luna's pregnancy circulates online. Lydia and Obet break out in a cold sweat following Tonio's disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Traitor
Episodes.Description: Harry seethes with rage after discovering the extent of Darius' betrayal. William and Cecille stop Gino from taking responsibility for Luna's pregnancy. Tim starts feeling conflicted about his budding attraction towards Poch.

Episodes.Title: Run
Episodes.Description: Believing that Luna's pregnancy holds the truth about her death, Sky convinces Obet and Gino to take a DNA test to find out the identity of the baby's father. A heated argument ensues between William and Gino concerning Sky's request.

Episodes.Title: False Hope
Episodes.Description: Obet turns to Harry for help in finding his brother as Tonio's call reignites Lydia's optimism. Although Gino agrees to cooperate with her, Sky's hope plummets on the day of the DNA testing.

Episodes.Title: Deal with the Devil
Episodes.Description: William strikes a deal with the school's former vice principal to prevent his son from getting dragged into Luna's death as Gino persists in taking the DNA test. Sky and Obet find comfort in each other's company amid their problems.

Episodes.Title: Case Reopened
Episodes.Description: Tania apologizes to Sky after learning that Luna did not commit suicide. As William fumes over Gino's veiled threat, news of the reopening of Luna's case spreads like wildfire at Northford.

Episodes.Title: Two Fathers
Episodes.Description: With her friends' help and despite Archie's attempt to sabotage them, Sky manages to raise money for her tuition fee. However, a new dilemma arises for Tania and Sky when both Gino's and Castrodes' DNA tests come back positive.

Episodes.Title: Retake
Episodes.Description: Tim finds out about his parents' impending separation. Tania and Sky demand a second DNA test from Gino and Castrodes to determine the truth between their conflicting results, much to William's frustration.

Episodes.Title: Daddy
Episodes.Description: Tim heads to a bar to drown his sorrow, only to come across Poch and learn about his darkest secret. Lydia finds herself in danger as she goes to great lengths just to find Tonio.

Episodes.Title: Broken Footage
Episodes.Description: William pulls strings to hide a piece of evidence that could implicate Gino in Luna's death. Tim lies to Roxy about what happened on the night he ran away from home. Lydia and Obet receive distressing news.

Episodes.Title: Willing Victim
Episodes.Description: Obet is left with no choice but to accept Darius' offer in a bid to pay for Lydia's treatment and therapy. Gino calls the police after seeing Cecille's condition.

Episodes.Title: Bracelet
Episodes.Description: All eyes are on Gino as he gets accused of killing Luna. Desperate to raise money for his grandmother's medical treatment, Obet returns to his old rogue ways. Lydia gives Sky a piece of evidence that may lead her to Luna's killer.

Episodes.Title: Inadmissible Evidence
Episodes.Description: Sky and Tania hand over the bracelet Lydia found at the place where Luna died to the police, only to learn that the piece of evidence is inadmissible. With this, Sky decides to take matters into her own hands and starts searching for its owner.

Episodes.Title: Caught on Cam
Episodes.Description: Archie walks right into Roxy and Tim's trap, unwittingly admitting that he is the person behind Roxy's business mishaps. Poch continues to make advances on Tim. Sky and Obet find a potential source of a vital CCTV footage of Luna's death.

Episodes.Title: Unforeseen Suspect
Episodes.Description: New CCTV footage on the night of Luna's death leads Sky and Obet to an unexpected addition to their list of suspects. Edith talks to Tim about her decision to file for annulment. Harry erupts in anger as he finally catches Sasha with her lover.

Episodes.Title: Adulterers
Episodes.Description: The cracks in the happy facade of the Aguerros' home turn into fissures when Harry sees Red and makes Sasha pay for cheating on him with Darius. Soon, he finds himself rushing to Tania's home upon getting wind of Sky's new discovery.

Episodes.Title: Questioning
Episodes.Description: Invited for questioning over Luna's death, Cecille suffers from an anxiety attack when the police show her the evidence Sky holds against her. Poch urges Tim to leave home and live with him amidst their mounting family problems.

Episodes.Title: The Secret is Out
Episodes.Description: Another secret is out as Sky and Z get into another heated fight in front of their schoolmates. The board members of Northford High School force William to step down as the school's president in light of the issues hounding Cecille.

Episodes.Title: Call for Justice
Episodes.Description: Gino convinces Cecille to give a statement about her meeting with Luna as a group of concerned citizens gathers in front of Northford High School. Tim vents out his frustrations to Elmo and comes out to him.

Episodes.Title: The Enabler
Episodes.Description: Gino confronts his mother for painting Luna in a bad light with her confession. Elmo urges Tim to come clean about his feelings to Roxy. Sky and Obet find another footage that can implicate Cecille.

Episodes.Title: Arrested
Episodes.Description: Sasha's father orders Darius to find a way to turn the police's attention away from Harry's disappearance. Looking for a more solid piece of evidence against Cecille, Sky spots a mobile number while scouring Luna's stuff.

Episodes.Title: Rage
Episodes.Description: Gino throws a fit of rage and beats up William upon learning of Cecille's arrest, believing that it was his father's fault. The governor's son later finds solace in Z's company. Meanwhile, Tim struggles to hide his true feelings from Roxy.

Episodes.Title: Special
Episodes.Description: Sky grows curious about a familiar pen in Luna's possession. Roxy decides to break up with Tim after he confesses about his special kiss with someone else. Drowning his sorrows in alcohol, Gino comes across a new face.

Entries.Title: The Rain in España
Entries.Description: Based on a hit Wattpad novel with more than 130 million reads. Luna and Kalix were still students, when their budding romance was cut short. Years after, fate finds a way for them to work together on a special project.

Episodes.Title: The Architect and the Lawyer
Episodes.Description: When Luna, an architecture student, meets Kalix, a pre-law student, she knows it's love at first sight so she makes the first move. Years after, Luna, now an architect, bumps into Kalix, now a lawyer, again but all she has for him is hatred.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Luna finds herself on Kalix's bed one morning. Via, Sam, Yanna and Kierra ask her about their real status, but she's as confused as them because she doesn't know if Kalix and Amethyst, a pre-law student, are together.

Episodes.Title: A Special Place
Episodes.Description: Sick of receiving mixed signals, Luna confronts Kalix about them. He takes her to a secret place where Luna will feel that she is special.

Episodes.Title: Best Trip Ever
Episodes.Description: Luna and Kalix spend their first romantic getaway as a couple in Boracay. Meanwhile, Kierra introduces her "boyfriend" Miguel to the girls. They start to suspect something is not right with the guy.

Episodes.Title: I Love NY
Episodes.Description: Luna and Kalix get to celebrate their first holiday season together in New York where many "firsts" happens, including meeting Kalix's parents.

Episodes.Title: Take Yourself to the Moon
Episodes.Description: Blaming herself for what happened to Kierra, Luna is at her lowest point. What makes it worse is that she finds out about Kalix's cheating. It is the end of LuKal?

Episodes.Title: Restart
Episodes.Description: Many years later, Kalix asks Luna to be the lead architect of his resthouse in Tagaytay. All conditions are met by Kalix to make sure he'll get her "YES".

Episodes.Title: Luna
Episodes.Description: Kalix and Luna together again... but just for a special project. Now that Luna becomes more open to work with Kalix, will she start to reopen her heart for him?

Episodes.Title: The Other Side of the Coin
Episodes.Description: All professionals now, Luna, Kierra, Yanna, Via and Sam set a vacation in Boracay. But as she tries to open her heart for him, her unresolved issues with Kalix resurface.

Episodes.Title: It's Always Been You
Episodes.Description: Luna and Kalix are back in each others' arms but their story isn't over yet for a big surprise is about to unfold.

Entries.Title: Royal Blood
Entries.Description: Follows the difficult journey of Napoy, an illegitimate son of a business tycoon and a loving single father, who struggles to make ends meet. Everything becomes complicated for Napoy when he becomes the primary suspect in his father's death.

Entries.Title: Linlang
Entries.Description: Victor “Bangis” Lualhati has always been a fighter. As a former boxer, he gets used to overcoming obstacles through tough times. However, when he finds a suspicious message on his wife's phone, he will be faced with a challenge he never saw coming. As Victor investigates, he discovers there is more at play than just a cheating spouse. The deeper he digs, the more shocking realizations he makes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Victor Lualhati is a former boxer turned seaman. All he wants in life is a complete and happy family with his wife, Juliana. Being away for a long time, Victor decides to take some time off from work to be with his family. However, as days pass, he notices significant changes in his wife. He then comes across a suspicious message from an unknown number on Juliana's phone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Juliana explains to Victor the reasons behind her sinful actions. However, Victor struggles to accept her explanation, leading to escalating domestic issues that put their daughter, Abby, in jeopardy. Determined to move forward, Victor attempts to put the betrayal behind him, only to stumble upon a shocking revelation: the true identity of Juliana's paramour.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Leaving no stone left unturned, Victor continues to investigate and befriends Juliana’s officemates to confirm the identity of his wife's paramour. Victor collapses during his boxing training and cleverly uses his medical predicament to entrap Juliana’s lover, which culminates in a bloody confrontation. Meanwhile, Amelia discovers Juliana's dark secret during the most important day of her career.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Victor reveals to the authorities that Juliana and Alex are having an extramarital affair. However, he lacks the concrete evidence needed to support his claim. To make matters worse, Sylvia's involvement in the matter adds to the complexity of the situation when she clears her husband’s name. Later, Juliana seeks an annulment citing Victor's psychological incapacity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Victor and Juliana are compelled to live together in the big house for Abby's sake. Surprisingly, their family dynamic starts to resemble what it used to be, triggering jealousy in Alex. Sylvia struggles with infertility and considers adoption as an option. Juliana discovers this, creating a rift in her relationship with Alex and putting their affair at risk of being exposed to their families.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As Juliana plans to sell their house to push her estranged husband to the limit, Victor returns to professional boxing with the help of an unlikely ally to provide for his family. Alex becomes a law firm partner. As the stakes get higher, Juliana makes a life-changing discovery that will ruin her and Alex for good. Suspicious of his wife’s actions, Victor stops at nothing to uncover her secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Kate feels betrayed after discovering her sister’s dirty secret with her own eyes. Tension escalates when Juliana receives a malicious after-party photo of Victor. Even after the DNA test proves that he is the father of Juliana's unborn child, Victor remains skeptical about the result. The uncertainty causes anxiety for everyone, and yet only one person among them already has the answer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After Juliana's attempted escape, Victor denies her access to Abby and keeps the child hidden away. However, witnessing Abby's distraught, Victor decides to negotiate with Juliana, offering to hold adultery charges in exchange for the child's custody. Despite Juliana's reluctance, she eventually agrees to the deal, until another deceitful plan occurs that only deepens Victor's mistrust of her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As the adultery court hearing looms, Victor taps the strongest witness he can find against Alex—his devoted wife, Sylvia. While seeking funds for his legal battle, Victor makes yet another earth-shattering discovery about his identity. Out of desperation, Alex and Juliana endanger the most important aspect of their relationship—their unborn child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: The loss of Juliana and Alex’s unborn child affects everyone, including Victor. To make matters worse, serious legal problems loom over the illicit couple now that Victor finally obtains solid evidence against them. Sylvia's love for Alex ends in a devastating tragedy. After a few years, many things have changed, and Victor's next steps will soon be revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After spending years in prison, Victor seeks to redeem all he has lost, especially his relationship with his daughter Abby. However, Juliana still harbors doubts about him, making it uncertain whether he can prove his innocence and regain the trust of those close to him. Meanwhile, Alex hopes to become a partner with Emilio's company, only to face opposition from an unknown source.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As Alex and Emilio’s partnership is in shambles, Victor tricks his brother into signing with a new boxing promotion. Things are slowly falling into place for Victor when he starts to regain Abby's affection and finally ties the knot with Olivia. Alex investigates the identity of the person who helps his brother, while Victor uncovers another lie concerning Sylvia’s demise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Victor orchestrates a plan to expose Alex's infidelity and abusive behavior toward Juliana. Filled with regrets for leaving Victor, Juliana finds herself in turmoil. Jealous of the ex-couple's rekindled connection, Olivia decides to intervene. However, her plan to drive Juliana away from her and Victor's lives takes a shocking turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: While Olivia remains missing, a battered Juliana comes home to Alex. Just when Victor finally acquires a video that could solve Sylvia's murder, Alex turns himself in to the authorities to make a confession. Meanwhile, Amelia is forced to choose between her principles and her son. In a death match between Alex and Victor, only one Lualhati emerges victorious.

Entries.Title: Niña Niño
Entries.Description: Niña and Niño move to the big city together and realize that life is anything but a bed of roses. They struggle to make ends meet as con-artists until an unexpected event changes their lives.

Entries.Title: Prima Donnas
Entries.Description: Married couple Jaime (Wendell Ramos), the sole inheritor to the affluent Claveria Group of Companies, and Maita (Glaiza de Castro), having trouble starting their family, hire Lilian (Katrina Halili), daughter of their most trusted house helper, to be their surrogate. Lilian accepts, and later she gives birth to three beautiful girls.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: The lives of married couple Jaime (Wendell Ramos) and Maita (Glaiza de Castro) have experienced difficulties in conceiving a child. This resulted to hiring Lilian (Katrina Halili), daughter of their most-trusted housemaid, to be the surrogate mother of their unborn child. However, conflicts start to arise when Kendra (Aiko Melendez) steps in the way to ruin Maita's growing family.
Lively sports commentary with columnist Dan Le Batard, his father Papi, and guest personalities.

Entries.Title: Bagani
Entries.Description: Five normal individuals from different regions of Sansinukob embark on a journey to protect their land from evil god, Sarimaw.

Episodes.Title: Unang Sabak ng Bagani
Episodes.Description: Lakas belongs to the desert tribe in the Sansinukob. Despite being the poorest among the five indigenous tribes, the desert dwellers thrive in combat, raising their children to become powerful warriors. However, Lakas struggles to fit in because his father, Agos, is deemed by their fellowmen as a traitor. Seeking redemption for his father, Lakas resolves to become a great warrior of his tribe. Meanwhile, Agos learns the shocking truth behind the real traitor among the desert dwellers.

Episodes.Title: Ang Lakas Ng Bagani
Episodes.Description: Learn the history of the people of the Taga-Disyerto and how it changed the life of Lakas, a warrior from the region. Lakas vows not to use his superior fighting skills for Dakim’s greed. Tragedy strikes when warriors from Taga-Kalakal tries to raid Taga-Disyerto. Lakas undertakes a brave move and warns people to "RUN!", but leads them the wrong way. The warriors of Taga-Disyerto take charge and fights the other region, but only to come across nothing because they went the opposite way. Lakas and the citizens of Taga-Disyerto comes across Tsga-Kalakal.

Episodes.Title: Ang Ganda Ng Bagani
Episodes.Description: As the desert dwellers fall into the trader army's trap, Lakas is left with no choice but to defend his tribe all by himself. Now fully aware of Lakas' unparalleled strength, Dakim forces the young warrior to serve him. The leaders of the desert dwellers give Lakas his first mission: to infiltrate the farming kingdom's impenetrable fortress. During his expedition, Lakas meets Ganda, a high-born from the land of the farmers.

Episodes.Title: Ang 3 Pang Bagani
Episodes.Description: Acknowledging Lakas' strength in combat, Ganda requests the warrior to train her people and help protect her prosperous kingdom from its enemies. However, Ganda remains unaware that Lakas is on a mission to infiltrate and invade her kingdom for the desert dwellers. Using his father Agos' teachings, Lakas trains the farming people in combat. Amid the rigorous training, Lakas starts to develop a close friendship with Ganda.

Episodes.Title: Pagsasanay Bagani Style
Episodes.Description: Soon after, Lakas learns Ganda's of tragic past. In the trading region, Lakam questions Ama's decision to blindside the farmers despite his betrothal with the farming kingdom's princess. Meanwhile, Mayari, a slave from the aquatic region, develops an admiration for the datu. Elsewhere, Dumakulem desires to venture past the domain of the forest kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Unang Pagsubok Sa Bagani
Episodes.Description: Lakas begins to bond with farmers of Taga-Patag, developing a soft spot for the kindhearted farmers. He finds it hard to let Dakim invade the peaceful kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Malakas Trumaydor Kay Ganda
Episodes.Description: However, Lakas crumbles at the sight of Lila being at the mercy of the greedy desert tribe leader. Hoping to avoid an unnecessary war between the two rival tribes, Dumakulem ventures to the fishing kingdom to seek an audience with Datu. Meanwhile, Lakam leads the traders' army in a surprise attack against the farming kingdom, bringing further bloodshed among the three tribes.

Episodes.Title: Ang Simula Ng Digmaan Sa Bagani
Episodes.Description: The war brings bloodshed between the tribes of Taga-Patag and Taga-Disyerto. Dakim and Lakas have a subtle argument. Dakim tries to murder Lakas, but fails when Ganda saves Lakas by stabbing Dakim before he could reach Lakas. The war then branches out, bringing Taga-Kalakal into the situation. Meanwhile, Dumakulem and Mayari attempt to stop a senseless war between Taga-Laot and Taga-Gubat. As chaos spreads across Sansinukob, the guardian deities Apo and Sarimaw grow concerned over the mortals’ abuse of freedom and bloodlust for power.
